L01.name: Molten Wave Oval Ring
L01.note: it is the owner's photo of the ring worn on a finger, with a tray of other rings blurred behind: take ONLY the ring on the finger and ignore the tray and every ring in it. IMAGE 2 is a closer crop of the same ring.
L01.lock: AN OPEN WRAP RING OF THREE MOLTEN GOLD STRANDS: three smooth, slightly irregular, high-polish gold strands, like poured liquid gold, sweep side by side across the top of the finger and fan apart. The outer strand is the thickest, about 2.5mm, swelling into a rounded droplet at its end; the middle strand is slimmer, about 1.5mm; the third, fine strand bends around ONE OVAL clear faceted stone held in four slim gold claws, so the oval sits at the front of the ring beside the strands, its long axis along the strands. The strands look hand-poured, with soft ripples, never machined.
L01.neg: Exactly one stone: one clear oval, never round, never pear; no pave, no halo, no other stones anywhere; the strands are smooth polished gold, never twisted rope, never textured; exactly three strands, never two, never four.
L01.scale: The oval stone is about 6x8mm, smaller than a fingernail; the strands are 1.5 to 2.5mm wide; at its widest the ring covers about 15mm.
L01.wscale: On the finger the ring covers about 15mm of the finger, never wider than the finger, and the oval stone is about a third of the finger's width.
L01.place: standing upright on the top face, the oval stone and the three strands facing the camera
L01.macro: the oval stone in its four claws and the three molten strands sweeping beside it

L02.name: Marquise Molten Bar Ring
L02.note: it is the owner's photo of the ring worn on a finger, with a tray of other rings blurred behind: take ONLY the ring on the finger. IMAGE 2 is a closer crop of the same ring.
L02.lock: AN OPEN TOI-ET-MOI RING: a slim polished gold band about 1.5mm wide that does NOT close. At one open end ONE large clear MARQUISE-cut faceted stone sits in four gold claws; at the other end the band rises into ONE long molten gold BAR, a smooth organic rod about 2.5mm thick, slightly wavy, with rounded droplet ends. The marquise and the bar lie side by side and parallel, both running ACROSS the finger.
L02.neg: Exactly one stone, a clear marquise, never round, oval or pear; no pave, no halo; the bar is smooth polished gold with soft ripples, never a straight machined bar, never set with stones; the band does not close.
L02.scale: The marquise is about 5x10mm; the molten bar is about 22mm long and 2.5mm thick, longer than the finger is wide.
L02.wscale: On the finger the marquise is about two thirds of the finger's width and the bar is a little longer than the finger is wide, overhanging it slightly at both ends; neither is ever larger.
L02.place: standing upright on the top face, the marquise and the molten bar side by side facing the camera, the open band behind
L02.macro: the clear marquise in its four claws beside the molten gold bar
L02.where: worn on the ring finger only, turned so the marquise and the molten bar both lie ACROSS the finger, at right angles to it and parallel to the band, side by side; the bar spans the whole width of the finger and its two rounded ends overhang the finger's sides a little; neither ever lies along the finger

L03.name: Twin Cluster Open Ring
L03.note: it is a frame from the owner's video of the ring worn on a finger over a tray of rings: take ONLY the ring on the finger. IMAGE 2 shows the same ring design from above, several of them lying in the tray.
L03.lock: AN OPEN CLUSTER RING: a broad polished gold band about 4mm wide that does NOT close; each open end carries a small cluster of clear faceted stones in raised gold claws on a gold base, and the two clusters face each other across the opening. One end: ONE clear PEAR (point toward the other end) beside ONE clear round stone. The other end: TWO clear PEAR stones lying tip to tip like a bow, with a row of tiny gold beads along the edge of the band beneath them. All stones clear.
L03.neg: Only clear stones: one pear and one round on one end, two pears on the other; never coloured stones, never a full pave band, never a closed band.
L03.scale: Each cluster is about 10 to 12mm across: the pears about 5x7mm, the round about 4mm; the band is about 4mm wide.
L03.wscale: On the finger the two clusters sit one above the other on top of the finger, each about two thirds of the finger's width, never wider than the finger.
L03.place: standing upright on the top face, the two clusters facing the camera across the opening
L03.macro: the two clusters facing each other: the pear and the round on one end, the two pears tip to tip on the other
L03.where: worn on the RING FINGER only (the fourth finger), the two clusters on top of the finger: one cluster a clear PEAR beside a clear ROUND stone, the other two clear PEARS lying tip to tip with a row of tiny gold beads beneath them, exactly as IMAGE 1 shows

L04.name: Lilac Flutter Studs
L04.note: it is the owner's photo of one stud on a white display ear held in a hand: take ONLY the stud; ignore the display ear, the hand and the ring on its finger. IMAGE 2 is a closer crop of the same stud.
L04.lock: A PAIR OF FOUR-STONE BUTTERFLY STUDS: each stud is FOUR faceted pale LILAC stones (a soft pale lavender with a hint of pink and bright white sparkle, never deep purple) in fine gold claws, set like butterfly wings around ONE tiny round gold bead at the centre: upper left a slim MARQUISE; upper right a SMALLER, SLIMMER MARQUISE, about three quarters the length of the upper-left one; lower left and lower right two larger PEARS, their points toward the centre and their round ends outward. A single post behind the centre.
L04.neg: Exactly four stones per stud, all the same pale lilac; never pink, never blue, never clear; no pave, no halo, no outline frame; the centre is one tiny gold bead; never more than one stud per ear.
L04.scale: Each stud is about 15mm across: the lower pears about 6x7mm, the marquise about 4x8mm, the smaller upper-right marquise about 3x6mm; an earlobe is about 18mm.
L04.wscale: On the lobe the stud covers most of the lobe, about 15mm, never larger than the lobe.
L04.place: both studs lying flat side by side on the top face, the stones facing up
L04.macro: ONE stud: its four lilac stones in their gold claws around the tiny gold bead

L05.name: Blush Octagon Studs
L05.note: it is the owner's photo of one stud on a white display ear held between finger and thumb: take ONLY the stud; ignore the display ear and the hand. IMAGE 2 is a closer crop of the same stud.
L05.lock: A PAIR OF OCTAGON SOLITAIRE STUDS: each stud is ONE OCTAGON-cut faceted stone with eight equal straight sides and a step-cut table, in a soft BLUSH PINK with peachy flashes, held in a slim gold setting with fine claws at its corners, on a single post.
L05.neg: Exactly one stone per stud; a regular octagon, never round, never square, never a hexagon; soft blush pink, never hot pink, never red, never lilac; no halo, no pave.
L05.scale: Each stone is about 9.5mm across, about half an earlobe.
L05.wscale: On the lobe the stud is about 9.5mm across, about half the lobe's width, never larger.
L05.place: both studs lying flat side by side on the top face, the octagon tables facing up
L05.macro: ONE stud: the blush octagon stone and its fine gold claws

L06.name: Baroque Pearl Duet Ring
L06.note: it is a close, soft crop of the ring on a finger: take ONLY the ring; it is a low-resolution image, so draw the pearl and the gold cleanly and sharply.
L06.lock: AN OPEN TOI-ET-MOI RING: a slim polished gold band that does NOT close. At one end ONE long BAROQUE shell pearl, elongated, about two and a half times as long as it is wide, with soft parallel ridges across it and a white lustre, held in a thin gold rim that follows its wavy outline. At the other end ONE smooth polished gold oval NUGGET, like a domed bean. The pearl and the nugget lie side by side and parallel, across the top of the finger.
L06.neg: Exactly one pearl and one gold nugget; the pearl is long and ridged, never round, never smooth; the nugget is plain polished gold, never textured, never set with stones; no other stones.
L06.scale: The pearl is about 15x6mm, the gold nugget about 10x6mm.
L06.wscale: On the finger the pearl lies across the finger and spans almost its whole width, about 15mm; the nugget is about two thirds of the pearl's length.
L06.place: standing upright on the top face, the pearl and the gold nugget side by side facing the camera
L06.macro: the ridged baroque pearl in its thin gold rim beside the polished gold nugget

L07.name: Two-Tone Heart Snake Chain
L07.note: it is the supplier's photo of the necklace worn with a fluffy white cardigan: take ONLY the necklace. IMAGE 2 is a closer crop of its row of hearts.
L07.lock: A TWO-TONE HEART NECKLACE: a flat, smooth, bright SILVER TONE snake chain about 3mm wide, threaded at the front with ELEVEN small puffed HEART beads in one row, alternating: a polished plain silver tone heart, then a gold tone heart covered in tiny clear pave stones, then silver again, and so on, starting and ending with silver (six silver hearts, five gold pave hearts). All hearts point down and touch each other.
L07.neg: Exactly eleven hearts, alternating silver and gold pave, never all gold, never all silver; the chain is a flat silver snake chain, never a cable or rope chain, never gold; no pendant.
L07.scale: Each heart is about 7mm across; the row of hearts is about 8cm wide; the chain is about 3mm wide.
L07.wscale: Worn, the row of hearts sits at the base of the neck and spans about a quarter of the neck's width; each heart is smaller than a fingernail.
L07.place: the necklace laid on the top face in a soft curve, the row of hearts at the front facing up
L07.macro: ONLY THREE HEARTS from the middle of the row, seen very close so they fill most of the frame: a polished silver tone heart, a gold tone heart paved with tiny clear stones and a polished silver tone heart, threaded on the flat silver snake chain; the rest of the necklace is out of frame, far closer than IMAGE 1

L08.name: Baguette Heart Necklace
L08.note: it is the supplier's product sheet on white, with printed measurements, dashed lines and a circled inset of the clasp: ignore every letter, number, line and the inset. IMAGE 2 is a closer crop of the heart.
L08.lock: A HEART PENDANT NECKLACE: a fine gold tone cable chain joined to BOTH upper sides of ONE domed polished gold HEART, through a small gold ring at the top of each lobe, so the heart sits in line with the chain. The heart's face is a recessed panel set with a MOSAIC of about ten clear BAGUETTE and small square stones standing upright in columns, edged with tiny gold beads, inside a smooth, rounded gold rim.
L08.neg: One heart only, joined at both upper lobes, never hanging from a single bail; the stones are clear baguettes standing upright, never round, never pave; the rim is smooth polished gold.
L08.scale: The heart is about 12mm across (1.19cm on the supplier's sheet); the chain is fine, about 1.5mm.
L08.wscale: Worn, the heart sits just below the hollow of the throat and is about 12mm, smaller than a fingertip.
L08.place: the necklace laid on the top face in a soft curve, the heart at the front facing up
L08.macro: the heart: its mosaic of upright clear baguettes, the tiny gold beads and the smooth gold rim

L09.name: Duet Emerald-Cut Cuff
L09.colour_note: (only the cuff whose emerald-cut stone is PINK)
L09.note: it is the supplier's photo of three such cuffs on a stone; they differ only in the colour of the emerald-cut stone (pink, clear or aqua): draw ONE cuff only, the one with the PINK emerald-cut stone. Ignore the rock. IMAGE 2 is a closer crop of the stones.
L09.lock: A SLIM OPEN CUFF BANGLE: a smooth round polished gold wire about 2mm thick, open at the front, its two ends side by side. One end carries ONE clear SQUARE cushion-cut stone in a four-claw gold box setting; the other end ONE PINK EMERALD-CUT (rectangular, step-cut) stone in a four-claw gold box setting, its long side along the wire.
L09.neg: Exactly two stones: one clear square and one pink emerald-cut rectangle; no pave; the wire is plain and smooth, never twisted; ONE cuff only.
L09.scale: The square stone is about 5mm and the emerald-cut about 4x6mm; the cuff is about 6cm across inside, with about 2cm between its two ends.
L09.wscale: On the wrist the two stones sit side by side on top of the wrist, each smaller than a fingernail; the wire is a fine line.
L09.wear: the opening and its two stones on top of the wrist
L09.place: lying on the top face, the opening and its two stones toward the camera
L09.macro: the two ends of the cuff: the clear square stone and the pink emerald-cut in their gold box settings

L10.name: Interlocked Baguette Trio Ring
L10.detname: IMAGE 2 shows the same ring worn by a model: use it only to see how the three bands sit together on the finger.
L10.note: it is the supplier's product sheet on white with printed labels and dashed lines: ignore every letter, number and line.
L10.lock: THREE INTERLOCKED BANDS worn as one ring, passing through each other so they roll freely: (1) a slim gold tone band about 2.5mm wide with a channel of small square-cut EMERALD-GREEN stones set edge to edge all the way round; (2) a plain polished SILVER tone band about 2.5mm wide; (3) a wider gold tone band about 5mm wide with round EMERALD-GREEN stones set flush in the metal, spaced apart around it. Worn stacked, the three make one ring about 11mm wide.
L10.neg: Exactly three bands: one green channel band, one plain silver band, one wide gold band with spaced round green stones; deep emerald green, never teal, never black; the silver band has no stones; never a single band.
L10.scale: The three bands together are about 11mm wide (supplier's sheet); the green square stones about 2mm; the round green stones about 3mm.
L10.wscale: On the finger the stacked bands cover about 11mm, about two thirds of the finger segment, never wider than the finger.
L10.place: standing upright on the top face, the three interlocked bands slightly fanned so all three show, as in IMAGE 1
L10.macro: the three interlocked bands: the green channel of square stones, the plain silver band and the round green stones set in the wide gold band
L10.where: worn on the ring finger only; the hand is held up FLAT in front of the collarbone with the BACK of the hand square to the camera and the fingers together pointing up, never touching the chin, the jaw or the neck

L11.name: Teardrop Pear Hoops
L11.detname: IMAGE 2 shows the same earring worn: the gold ear cuff above it is NOT part of the product; use IMAGE 2 only for the earring's size against the ear.
L11.note: it is the supplier's photo of the earrings in gold (left) and silver (right) hanging from a torn paper edge: draw ONLY the GOLD pair; ignore the silver pair and the paper.
L11.lock: A PAIR OF CHUNKY TEARDROP HOOPS: each earring is a thick, puffed, high-polish gold tone hoop shaped like a long teardrop in side view, narrow at the top where it enters the lobe and swelling to a rounded bulb at the bottom, open at the back with a hinged snap. At its lower back edge ONE clear PEAR-cut stone in three fine gold claws sits beside the hoop, point up, so the stone peeks out next to the hoop's lower end.
L11.neg: Exactly one stone per earring, a clear pear, point up; the hoop is smooth polished metal, never textured, never pave; a teardrop profile, never a round hoop; no ear cuff.
L11.scale: Each hoop is about 20mm tall and about 7mm thick at its widest; the pear is about 6x9mm.
L11.wscale: On the lobe the hoop hangs about 20mm, about the height of the earlobe, with the pear beside its lower end; never larger.
L11.place: both earrings standing side by side on the top face, the pear stones on the outer sides, as in IMAGE 1
L11.macro: ONE earring: the polished teardrop hoop and the clear pear in its claws beside it

L12.name: Baguette Heart Studs

L12.neg: One heart per stud; clear baguettes standing upright, never round, never pave; smooth gold rim; never more than one stud per ear.
L12.scale: Each heart is about 14mm wide, a little wider than it is tall.
L12.wscale: On the lobe the heart covers most of the lobe, about 14mm, never larger than the lobe.

L13.name: Lattice Lace Ring
L13.note: it is the supplier's photo of the ring worn on a hand holding a bag strap: take ONLY the ring. IMAGE 2 is a closer crop of it.
L13.lock: A WIDE OPENWORK LATTICE RING: a broad gold tone band about 15mm wide at the front, made of an open DIAMOND LATTICE of fine gold wires, each wire finely beaded like a row of tiny grains, with a small round gold dot where the wires cross, and a softly scalloped edge on both sides. L14.name: Zigzag Gem Eternity Ring

L16.name: Charm Chain Duo Ring
